_anchors.canvas.w: 40. The cross is the widest at 11 px of arm plus the outline ring; 40 leaves room for the moss to sit proud of it.
_anchors.canvas.h: 40. The cross stands 26 px above its own base — the height that makes it the stone only the somersault clears — and the footing sinks 3 below.
_anchors.canvas.originX: canvas.w / 2. An obstacle is symmetric about the point the game places it at.
_anchors.canvas.originY: 36, and it is ON THE GROUND LINE. The only row of an obstacle that anything cares about is where it meets the floor. The game reads each stone HEIGHT from its own crop, so a stone that is redrawn taller becomes harder with no number changed anywhere else.
_anchors.tones.perMaterial: 5, the Chrono idiom, and the SOTN reference spends it asymmetrically: four of the bone's five tones sit below the midpoint.
_anchors.frames.walk: **1, and it is the first single-frame subject in this project.** A gravestone does not move. The climb's shelves were given a sway because eight identical frames is a lie in the data; declaring one frame is the honest way to say the same thing, and it costs a twelfth of the wire.
_anchors.light.x: -0.5, upper left, as every subject except the astronaut.
_anchors.light.y: -0.62, and it is LOWER than the garden's -0.72. A graveyard at night is lit from a moon near the horizon, and a low lamp is what puts a rim on a skull instead of a wash over it.
_anchors.light.z: -0.22, barely toward the viewer. Less front light than the kitten: SOTN wants the form to fall away, so the light grazes.
_anchors.light.curve: 1.3, and it is the highest in the project. Above 1 the dark end compresses into a rim, which is exactly the SOTN value structure — a mass that reads as one dark shape with a bright edge on it.
_anchors.gait.swing: 0.02. Unused — nothing here has a track — and anchored so a stone that ever cracks has an amplitude to spend.
_anchors.gait.depth: 6 px. Unused; every clip is authored in the screen plane, which is the finding of this round.
_anchors.body.scale: 1. A slab is 13 px wide against the skeleton's 30 — small enough to clear in one jump and large enough to read three obstacles away.
_anchors.shadow.steps: 7, one more than the deepest mass (the ribcage at 4.2, the shroud at 3).
_anchors.shadow.strength: 2 ramp steps, matching the skeleton. One moon, one graveyard.
_anchors.fill.weight: 0.06, against the garden's 0.16. Almost no bounce: there is no foliage overhead and the ground is wet stone. The declared cost of a fill is that it compresses the value range, and this is the one subject in the project that cannot afford to lose any.
_anchors.playback.msPerFrame: 100. Unused with one frame; kept so the field is never absent.
_anchors.outline.material: "ink". Near black with a blue cast, because the ground is indigo and a warm line would separate from the scene rather than from the body.
_anchors.outline.inner: true, and every stone is welded so the line lands only where a footing meets a body. A slab and its plinth are one carved object.
